announced on Thursday that applications are open for its 2026 Toast Changemakers Program, which will award $150K in grants to 15 U.S. restaurants, with each recipient receiving $10K to support community feeding efforts.
The program is part of Toast's $5M, five-year commitment to combating food insecurity. The company said the first year of the program received more than 800 applications.
The 2026 program is open to eligible U.S. restaurants, cafes, food trucks, and bars, including businesses that are not Toast customers.
Toast is running the program in partnership with Hello Alice and the Global Entrepreneurship Network.
Applications opened Thursday, September 10, with a deadline of Thursday, October 1.
Moreover, the company will announce the 15 grant recipients on Tuesday, November 10, 2026.
The company said the program aims to help restaurants expand their efforts to fight hunger and strengthen their impact in local communities.

title: Toast opens $150K grant program for restaurants fighting hunger
